scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:css
scripts.build:js: bun build src/client/index.ts --outfile public/js/gif.gg.js --target browser --format esm --minify --reject-unresolved && bun build src/client/gif-worker.ts --outfile public/js/gif-worker.js --target browser --format esm --minify --reject-unresolved
scripts.build:encoder: cargo build --manifest-path tools/msf-gif/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --locked --offline && cp tools/msf-gif/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/gifgg_msf.wasm public/js/msf-gif.wasm
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun test
